title: Sean Evans Steps Up as Assistant Coach and Rebounding Coordinator at Queens University - NewsBreak
text:
By BVM Sportsdesk, ,
1 days ago Sean Evans has been promoted to Assistant Basketball Coach and Rebounding Coordinator at Queens University of Charlotte, after a successful inaugural season as the Director of Player Development. Under his guidance, the Royals celebrated their first ASUN Tournament title and recorded a 21-win season, the best since moving to Division 1. Coach Grant Leonard praised Evans' skills, saying he has remarkable relationships with players and exceptional basketball knowledge. Evans’ impact helped produce three All-ASUN honorees and he contributed to an offense that ranked 18th nationally. Read full article
